<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and Yield Pressures:</strong> The Indian rupee remains under pressure due to elevated US bond yields and persistent FII outflows, forcing the RBI to act as a buffer for the domestic currency.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTFBsTmF2aEtlY0VGTHc1eWNqYnU1bFlJRnVYaXNMTUJIZm80VjRTVW9KS1FxY3VPVUJRUHdWZy01V09NcXpfMjR2SUptNDUwUkI0TTgw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxQTUlsSHkxcnpDbnA5WEwxYmhPSm5tMlBIRFJPS29xUUo3TkdWVF9qTFBaSGFQVFFvYlV5SDY5WnMwQklfTnlyQkxjeU9GcWZfeTNnejBBNWVkMUNfVElidVNTZnUyd09OM0NvMUMwT21LTUViOEFtLUtiZ3pCS21mY2gydGxvRndQRHZxNmJ4VC1uczcxSWltSlV6UVpBNXYwaFUzaXZCOF9fOGpNdklWQzZYdjlTRm5F?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
